Title: Diplomacy
Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Andrew Bampfield
Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Plot: Henriette suffers a miscarriage, but Louis wants her to visit her brother in England for an alliance against the Dutch. The Chevalier, destined for the gallows, is freed. Montcourt foils an assassination just to be reinstated.
